tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink: the logo's outlines, the word "Iron", dark brand surfaces. For UI text use `text`, which follows the theme.

tokens.name: royal
tokens.usage: Brand primary: the word "Dost", the iron's body. UI actions use `primary`, which is royal in light mode.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Water and fills in illustrations; accent text on dark grounds only (2.3:1 on white, never text on light).

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: Sky's text-safe partner on light grounds (5.1:1 on white): the tagline, informational links.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Offers, savings and highlights. Always carries `ink` text (10.8:1), never white.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Soft brand panels and the washer's control panel in illustrations.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Washer and iron bodies in illustrations; logo ground.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards, lists and sheets.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, app bars and the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Grouped panels inside a card, skeleton loaders, unselected chips.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Snackbars only. Status summaries use surface and text in both themes; do not invert the entire tracking hero.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-soft`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and inactive icons on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-soft`.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Action text on `surface-inverse`, e.g. the snackbar's "Undo" (light 7.3:1, dark 5.8:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action per screen, links, selected states, progress. On `surface` and `bg`: light 6.8:1, dark 6.5:1.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chips and slots, the active tab indicator, info fills. Pair with `on-primary-soft`.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Informational accents: the live-tracking line, "Partner on the way", the out-for-delivery chip. Light is `ocean` deepened for small text: 6.4:1 on `surface`, 5.5:1 on `surface-soft`; dark is `sky` (7:1, 6:1).

tokens.name: offer
tokens.usage: Small offer benefit marker only; no full-screen promotional fill. Always pair with on-offer.

tokens.name: on-offer
tokens.usage: Text on `offer`.

tokens.name: offer-soft
tokens.usage: Large promo backgrounds; text on it is `text`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, paid, savings amounts. On `surface` 5.8:1 / 8.6:1; on `success-soft` 5.1:1 / 6.8:1. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success chips and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unpaid amounts, slots closing soon. On `warning-soft` 5.3:1 / 8.4:1.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, cancellation, account deletion. On `surface` 5.6:1 / 7:1; on `danger-soft` 4.9:1 / 7.1:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and the cancelled chip.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines (decorative, never the only boundary of a control).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outline-button borders: ≥3:1 on `surface` and `bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard and switch-access focus ring, offset 2px; ≥6.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: illo-steel
tokens.usage: Illustration: the iron's soleplate and metal parts.

tokens.name: illo-ring
tokens.usage: Illustration: the washer door ring.

tokens.name: illo-glass
tokens.usage: Illustration: glass and window highlights.

tokens.name: illo-foam
tokens.usage: Illustration: soap bubbles and foam.

tokens.name: illo-chrome
tokens.usage: Illustration: chrome highlights.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Totals and big numbers: the order total, the OTP digits.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Main screen heading; never repeated as a heading inside every card.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Compact app bar title and section heading.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, item names, list row labels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We pick up, iron and deliver to your door.
styles.usage: Input text and comfortable reading copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting timestamps and helpers; actionable links still get a 48 dp hit area.

spacing.note: 4-point rhythm. 20 dp default side gutter, 16 dp for long text/lists at 320 dp; section gaps 24 or 32 dp. Controls retain minimum 48 dp targets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items; minimum gap between touch targets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and list rows; gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of hero and promo cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a screen's first heading; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large breaks, e.g. above the sign-in form.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, thumbnails, admin buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: App buttons, inputs, OTP boxes, slot tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Only grouped address/order panels that require an enclosing boundary. Ordinary lists use dividers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of modal sheets; not a default hero shape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and compact status chips only; do not use for every button or stepper.

shadow.note: Shadows only in light mode; dark mode separates with `border` and lighter surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting content is flat; separate with spacing or a decorative divider.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating elements: the cart bar, menus, snackbars.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Actual modal sheets only. Sticky action bars use a top divider, not a sheet shadow.

size.note: Fixed sizes in logical pixels (dp / pt).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable area for any control, even when the visible icon is smaller.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Text fields and the phone field.

tokens.name: app-bar
tokens.usage: Top app bar height (plus the status-bar safe area).

tokens.name: bottom-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation height (plus the home-indicator safe area).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and captions.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, list rows and fields.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: App bar and bottom navigation icons.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Item and service thumbnails in lists.
